# TECH360 LLC

> TECH360 LLC designs and builds custom websites, CRM systems, client portals, eCommerce platforms, business dashboards and workflow automation for organisations worldwide. Every engagement is governed by a written Scope of Work: deliverables, USD price, schedule and payment milestones are agreed in writing, an HTML preview is supplied before the applicable payment only where the agreed process includes one, and source code is handed over after all required payments are verified and cleared.

- Legal name: TECH360 LLC (Missouri LLC LC014737249)
- Website: https://bdtech360.com
- Email: info@bdtech360.com
- Telephone: +1 (816) 380-8660
- Registered address: 117 S Lexington St Ste 100, Harrisonville, MO 64701, USA
- Language: English · Currency: USD

## Core AI and automation solutions

- [AI Agent Systems](https://bdtech360.com/services/ai-agent-systems): bounded assistants with defined tools, permissions, execution history and human approval gates for sensitive actions.
- [AI Business Automation](https://bdtech360.com/services/ai-business-automation): document intake, classification, routing and approval-gated back-office workflows.
- [WhatsApp AI Sales CRM](https://bdtech360.com/services/whatsapp-ai-sales-crm): one shared conversational inbox, qualification and a sales pipeline recorded against a single Client ID.
- [WhatsApp Automation](https://bdtech360.com/services/whatsapp-automation): opted-in order, booking and milestone messaging with delivery records.
- [WhatsApp Cloud API Integration](https://bdtech360.com/services/whatsapp-cloud-api-integration): official Meta Cloud API webhooks, templates and shared-inbox sync.
- [n8n Workflow Automation](https://bdtech360.com/services/n8n-workflow-automation): self-hosted multi-system orchestration with retry, idempotency and error logs.
- [Email Automation](https://bdtech360.com/services/email-automation): transactional receipts, onboarding sequences and deliverability setup.
- [SMS Automation](https://bdtech360.com/services/sms-automation): OTP verification, appointment reminders and time-critical alerts.

## Usage notes for agents

- All published information is public marketing and contact information. No customer records, invoices, credentials or private project data are exposed by any public endpoint.
- Prices are quoted per engagement in a written proposal; nothing on this site is a price, quote or guarantee of a specific outcome.
- `/portal`, `/admin` and `/pipeline` are authenticated surfaces and are not part of this index.
- `robots.txt` carries `Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-train=no`. This is an emerging, non-standardised preference. It is not a technical or legal restriction on training.
